notes.title: Stay! Stay! DPRK Adult Patch is out Now!
notes.content:
Adult Patch Release
You guys knew this day would come... the Stay! Stay! DPRK: Glorious Waifu Edition adult patch is finally out!

Click here to visit our website where you can download it now!

DLC Music Release
Also, don't think we forgot all you guys asking for a way to get the soundtrack! We've put that up on Steam for you guys to pick up, if you like the music and feel like chipping a couple of bucks our way to help us fund our next game, Mein Waifu is the Fuhrer.

You can pick up the soundtrack here on Steam by clicking on the picture below!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/659710/header.jpg?t=1498165375
